The FloPlast 110mm grey push-fit socket plug provides a reliable solution for sealing unused openings in soil and vent drainage systems. Constructed from durable uPVC, this lightweight plug ensures strength and longevity in plumbing installations. It is designed for easy push-fit installation and is suitable for high temperature waste water discharges. Ideal for plumbers and builders working on various projects, the plug effectively seals off sections of the soil stack, preventing unwanted odours or debris. For optimal jointing, applying silicone lubricant to seals is recommended, ensuring a secure and leak-free connection.
